subject: partition: reorganized the execution order of partition table update operators (#52442)
summary: Changes are confined to `pkg/table/tables` (plus new integration coverage). The commit adds a txn mem-buffer staging scope to `partitionedTableUpdateRecord` and switches cross-partition updates to remove-then-add so global unique index keys get deleted before re-created, while still rolling back the whole multi-step update on error; it also removes the prior global-index “overwrite existing key” behavior in `index.Create`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched table behavior after inspecting the minimal relevant surrounding code and later upstream history.
